description: Phenomenological single-mode truncated Kerr GKSL steady-state toy model

epistemic_verdict.finding: The single-mode truncated Kerr GKSL toy model achieves an exact numerical steady state (||L(rho)||_2 = 9.384427e-17) and a positive normalized density matrix. The code checks trace, Hermiticity and eigenvalues only; it does not evaluate the Spohn functional or derive microscopic quantum-gravity couplings.
